title: マイルCS南部杯の後に・キラキラ繋ぐ

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the winner is Yukino Bijin! With that fierce performance, she's pulled off a truly splendid homecoming!

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yowza! That sure was someth'n! Yukino's just the bee's knees!

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: She's seriously the cat's meow…

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …H-hold on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Now, I know I don't know everyth'n about your situation.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And… runn'n in the big leagues can get pretty darn tough…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I've had a lotta fun chas'n my dream! I just want you t'know that!

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I know. I'm an Umamusume too, y'know. I can tell just from watch'n you run.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You've worked hard t'dazzle the way you do.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y'know, I think I just might keep runn'n a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I wanted t'give up 'cause I figured I've got no talent. But it doesn't take anyth'n special t'give up. I can do that anytime.

text_block_list.name: Young Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text: For now, I wanna be the second Star of Morioka! …Or am I aim'n too high?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Us Umamusume from Morioka are walk'n, talk'n bundles o'guts! You've got what it takes f'sure!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Yukie-poo and her trainer! So this is where y'were!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident A
text_block_list.text: It's time for your celebration shindig! We can't get started without the star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident A
text_block_list.text: 'Course y'are! You're a star among stars! You've gotta tell us all 'bout how Yukino's doing out in the city!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident A
text_block_list.text: We've got you a room in the best inn around! Oh, and I've gotta ask… Do you like t'drink?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident B
text_block_list.text: This one's been full of pep since she was a li'l squirt! She'd go sneak'n into every house she could!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident C
text_block_list.text: I see your glass's empty, Trainer! This here's actually my shop, so lemme top you up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident D
text_block_list.text: Yep, city folk sure are a diff'rent sort! Say, have you got a special somebody?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oooh, you guys! Stop giv'n my trainer a hard time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer! They're all nice people, really… They can just get outta hand when it comes to party'n…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ngh. You're just too kind…

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident E
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer, Yukino's our pride and joy, y'know! You better keep tak'n good care of her!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: That's right! She's the Star of Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Geez. You're all tipsy as anyth'n.
choice_data_list: What a lovely group of people.
What a lovely group of people.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. They sure are. I love 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident F
text_block_list.text: Trainer! D'you know how t'dance?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Hometown Resident F
text_block_list.text: C'mon over here! I'll teach you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Now hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I thought this was s'posed to be a vict'ry party?! Don't go forc'n my trainer t'put on some kinda p'formance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we spend a cozy night in Morioka, warmed by the locals' laughter.
